name: @nostr-window/fedos-desktop-electron-spike
description: The real FedOS Desktop Beta Electron app and its release-build pipeline (release:beta/package:beta). The pipeline produces UNSIGNED Windows artifacts -- no Authenticode code signing is performed or configured; see SECURITY.md and docs/pilot/KNOWN_RISKS.md. Despite the package name (kept unchanged in this Arc; renaming it touches every --prefix script site and is its own separately-scoped Arc, see docs/reviews/fedos_dead_runtime_production_path_v1/07_misleading_naming.md item 4), this is not a throwaway spike. Originally created (Alpha 3881-3940/4021-4100) as an Electron dependency/build spike physically isolated as its own package so Electron's own transitive @types/node dependency never leaks into the root application's TypeScript graph -- that isolation reason still holds and is why it remains a separate package.

scripts.build: node ../../node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json && node ../../node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.browser-scripts.json && node scripts/copy_static_assets.mjs
scripts.start: npm run ensure-electron-binary && npm run build && electron dist/fedos_electron_spike_main.cjs
scripts.start:host-adapter: npm run build:host-bridge --prefix ../.. && npm run build && electron dist/fedos_electron_host_adapter_main.cjs
scripts.start:navigation: npm run build:runtime --prefix ../.. && npm run build && electron dist/fedos_electron_navigation_main.cjs
scripts.start:notifications-tray: npm run build:runtime --prefix ../.. && npm run build && electron dist/fedos_electron_notifications_tray_main.cjs
scripts.start:badge: npm run build:runtime --prefix ../.. && npm run build && electron dist/fedos_electron_badge_main.cjs
scripts.start:unlock: npm run build:unlock-runtime --prefix ../.. && npm run build && electron dist/fedos_electron_unlock_main.cjs
scripts.start:settings: npm run build:settings-host-bridge --prefix ../.. && npm run build && electron dist/fedos_electron_settings_main.cjs
scripts.start:beta: npm run ensure-electron-binary && npm run build:beta-runtime --prefix ../.. && npm run build && electron dist/fedos_electron_beta_main.cjs
scripts.package:beta: npm run build:beta-runtime --prefix ../.. && npm run build && node scripts/run_electron_builder_package_beta.mjs
